message: stop data does not match the workflow return type
why: `workflow.stop` returns its data to the caller, so the data has to be the type the workflow declares. Stop writes straight into the return slot, so a mismatch is a `ret` of the wrong type: it compiles and the caller reads garbage.
fix: pass a value of the declared return type
or change the workflow's declared return type to the type you pass
